definition: Founder approves specified content, disposition, or next step.
minimum_evidence: Durable Founder record, exact content/scope, conditions.
allowed_next_event: Adoption or bounded certified action if authorized.
does_not_imply: Adoption, lock, activation, implementation, verification, operations, pilot, or production unless expressly included.

definition: Artifact becomes governing authority within stated level and scope.
minimum_evidence: Exact artifact identity, scope, exclusions, retained findings.
allowed_next_event: Lock or accession pending if authorized.
does_not_imply: Lock, accession, custody, activation, implementation, runtime, pilot, or production.

minimum_evidence: Hash, byte length, lock record, retained-risk treatment.
does_not_imply: Repository custody, activation, implementation, pilot, or production.

definition: Exact bytes added to authorized repository path/commit.
does_not_imply: Custody, activation, implementation, pilot, or production.

definition: Protected repository state verifies exact bytes.
minimum_evidence: Protected commit, path, SHA-256, byte length, PR/merge receipts.
does_not_imply: Adoption, activation, implementation, verification, operations, pilot, or production.

minimum_evidence: Activation record, effective date, scope, exclusions, stop conditions.
does_not_imply: Application implementation, pilot, or production unless expressly granted.

minimum_evidence: Directive or RF/work package, paths, environment, rollback, evidence.
does_not_imply: Verification, operational readiness, pilot, production, or release.

definition: Checks, reviews, tests, substitutions, waivers, and defects are dispositioned against exact baseline.
does_not_imply: Operational readiness, pilot, or production authority.

definition: Operational support and release readiness accepted by competent authority.
minimum_evidence: Owners, runbooks, monitoring, incident, backup, restore, rollback, provider evidence or certification.
allowed_next_event: Pilot authorization or production authorization if expressly granted.

minimum_evidence: Pilot plan, cohort, environment, flags, stop conditions, Founder or delegated authority.
allowed_next_event: Pilot evidence collection and later release determination.

definition: Production activation authorized for identified release/environment/feature/providers/data/user population.
minimum_evidence: Exact head/release, evidence, exceptions, retained risks, authority, effective date.
allowed_next_event: Production activation receipt and maintenance cycle.

definition: Founder determines evidence, process, exception, or retained risk is sufficient for stated bounded purpose.
minimum_evidence: Certification class, scope, evidence, authority effect, prohibited claims, review trigger, durable approval.
allowed_next_event: Bounded continuation, closure with exception, or express production authorization with exceptions.
does_not_imply: External assurance, production authority, or historical fact change unless expressly and truthfully stated.
